content: Google is seemingly working on an item tracker that might compete with Apple’s AirTag. 9to5Google obtained an image of something called a “Google Pixel Tag” that has a small oval shape. The publication also linked to a Slovenian store listing about the Pixel Tag that describes the gadget as an item tracker with a speaker that uses Google’s “Find My Device” network (which is now called Find Hub). The Pixel Tag is popping up shortly ahead of Google’s planned hardware launch event for August 12th. Google has already shown off teases of the Pixel 11 lineup for the event, and leaks have also appeared for a new foldable, smartwatch, and earbuds. Earlier this month, 9to5Google noted that early Pixel 11 listings mentioned a Google Pixel Tag but pointed out that “no such tracker exists right now.” Here’s a machine translation of the Pixel Tag’s description from the Slovenian listing: > The Google Pixel Tag smart tracker helps you quickly and reliably locate your lost items using the secure “Find My Device” network. > Never waste time searching for your keys, wallet or luggage again. Google Pixel Tag is a compact, lightweight and durable smart tracker that attaches discreetly to your most important items. Using Google’s extensive and secure “Find My Device” network, you can always check the exact location of your belongings via your smartphone. The tracker is equipped with a loud speaker for easy nearby search and is designed with your privacy and personal data in mind. Google didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment.

chineseContent: 谷歌似乎正在开发一款可能与苹果 AirTag 竞争的物品追踪器。 9to5Google 获得了一张名为“Google Pixel Tag”的图像，其形状为小椭圆形。该出版物还链接到斯洛文尼亚有关 Pixel Tag 的商店列表，该列表将该小工具描述为带有扬声器的物品跟踪器，使用谷歌的“查找我的设备”网络（现在称为 Find Hub）。 Pixel Tag 将在 Google 计划于 8 月 12 日举行的硬件发布会之前不久出现。谷歌已经在此次活动中展示了 Pixel 11 系列的预告片，并且还泄露了新的可折叠智能手表和耳机的信息。本月早些时候，9to5Google 指出，早期的 Pixel 11 列表中提到了 Google Pixel Tag，但指出“目前不存在这样的跟踪器”。以下是斯洛文尼亚列表中 Pixel Tag 描述的机器翻译： > Google Pixel Tag 智能跟踪器可帮助您使用安全的“查找我的设备”网络快速可靠地找到丢失的物品。 > 再也不用浪费时间寻找钥匙、钱包或行李了。 Google Pixel Tag 是一款紧凑、轻便且耐用的智能跟踪器，可谨慎地附加到您最重要的物品上。使用 Google 广泛且安全的“查找我的设备”网络，您可以随时通过智能手机检查您的物品的确切位置。该追踪器配备了扬声器，可轻松进行附近搜索，并且在设计时充分考虑了您的隐私和个人数据。谷歌没有立即回复置评请求。
